verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an online government filing and search service, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only the browser-based SOSPortal (filing, drafts, My Submissions, shopping cart, MFA) and downloadable PDF forms, with no mention of a CLI or any programmatic tooling. The filing host's robots.txt also bans AI agents by name, which points away from agent-friendly tooling.
